conditional_resampling_scope: Resample successful matched paired blocks within each fixed observed window, retaining all window sample sizes. This descriptive calculation assumes exchangeability of these paired blocks and does not model serial/domain dependence; its interval can be too narrow. It does not estimate network/day population coverage.

historical.scope: The pooled historical statistic describes exactly these six fixed windows. Its conditional resampling interval resamples within each window while retaining every window. It is not a population confidence interval. Retrospective held-window and held-date checks reuse selected historical data; they are not a prospective prediction experiment. The median of window medians gives one weight to each observed window, a different statistic from the pooled pair median.

validation.notes: Successful persistent UDP/H2 records retain exactly one local port per provider/window; H2 also retains one connection identity and unchanged metadata. Every successful wire response is independently decoded. Stage values are finite and nonnegative and UDP stage arithmetic is checked.

baseline_swap_summary.note: Every window uses the same complete three-treatment matched blocks. Difference of two window effect medians is not the median of paired baseline shifts. At individual matched-block level, (DoH−bound)−(DoH−fresh)=fresh−bound.

forecast_validation.target: For EACH follow-up matched measurement window, median of paired established DoH elapsed_ms minus fresh UDP elapsed_ms INCLUDING explicit socket creation and bind setup will be greater than zero. Exact labels: doh_warm minus udp_fresh.
forecast_validation.caveat: The follow-up fresh UDP explicitly binds inside elapsed_ms; the historical client uses implicit bind. This is a prospective sign transport check under an implementation change, not exact validation of an identical estimator or a pure network/cryptography estimate.

control.timing_scope: elapsed_ms is the reported whole measured call: fresh UDP includes explicit create/bind; bound UDP and established DoH exclude already completed setup. transport_elapsed_ms is the common UDP send-call-to-receipt stage after bind, excluding validation. post_bind_query_ms is used only if explicitly recorded, never guessed from undocumented stage offsets. Persistent source-port/network/cache affinity and different protocol libraries remain alternative explanations.
